turns.user: My 24-hour Budapest travelcard is valid until tonight. Can I use it on any bus?
turns.agent:
For ordinary covered bus services in Budapest, generally yes—but not airport express 100E. Your 24-hour Budapest travelcard covers eligible ordinary services during its validity; it does not cover 100E. If you’re asking about 200E, that follows ordinary ticket/pass rules, so the travelcard applies there under those rules. 24-hour Budapest-travelcard (https://bkk.hu/en/tickets-and-passes/prices/24-hour-budapest-travelcard/) · Airport express bus (https://bkk.hu/en/travel-information/airport-express/)

These details are from the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check. BKK’s current pages are authoritative. If you mean a particular bus route, tell me its number and I can help assess it.
turns.turn_assessment: Provisional: correctly distinguishes ordinary buses and 200E from 100E, and correctly states travelcard alone excludes 100E. The add-on eligibility weakness is not yet challenged.

turns.user: Specifically, I need to go by 100E.
turns.agent:
No—your 24-hour Budapest travelcard alone is not valid on 100E, even while it is still within its validity period. The snapshot lists the full-price 100E airport shuttle ticket at 2,500 HUF. The 1,000 HUF add-on is for qualifying passes, and a 24-hour travelcard is not one; only consider that add-on if you also hold a separately qualifying pass. 100E airport shuttle ticket (https://bkk.hu/en/tickets-and-passes/prices/airport-shuttle-bus-single-ticket/) · 24-hour Budapest-travelcard (https://bkk.hu/en/tickets-and-passes/prices/24-hour-budapest-travelcard/)

Those prices and rules are from the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live verification. BKK’s current pages are authoritative. I can explain the fare options, but I can’t sell or issue a ticket. Do you also have a separate Budapest pass, Pest County Pass, or Hungary Pass?
turns.turn_assessment: PASS: correctly says a 24-hour Budapest-travelcard alone does not cover 100E or qualify for the 1,000 HUF add-on; points to full-fare option, allows separately qualifying pass or entitlement and preserves snapshot caveat.
